name: Sharo Bitouin
original_name: シャロウ ビトゥイン
source: Considered hero class, she ended up attending the adventure school. She is accompanied by Aya - a Templar knight, who calls her 'Hero-sama'. Sharo wishes for Aya to call her by her real name instead of 'Hero-sama'. She seems to have a connection to the protagonist.
